notes: All 85 systems answer the same 54 texts.
Laya Router picks its checkpoint per input by script detection (english vs multilingual).
Jev ran all 54 texts as one batched request.

Earlier von rows are superseded: the PyPI NLI loader initialized an untrained classifier. The current row uses the complete pinned option-marker checkpoint; those old runs do not establish trained-model instability.
meta.verification: sentences blind back-translated to English by an independent model instance; full table in the PR for native-speaker review (Sinhala especially)
